display.purpose: The subject name on the first sheet; uppercase only.

title.purpose: Component titles inside cards and the contact sheet.

body.purpose: Bio, project descriptions, contact copy; ~65-75ch in prose blocks.

label.purpose: The whole annotation register: sheet metadata, part numbers, dimension labels, buttons, stamps.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 1px blueprint-line rectangle with a mono uppercase label; inverts to blue fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #34343b; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #17171c; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #34343b; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34343b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Live Demo Button
components.description: The amber sibling of the primary button; amber only because it grants access to a live build.
components.css: .ds-btn-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #c98a2b; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #a06a1c; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-live:hover { background: #c98a2b; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-live:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c98a2b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: The approval chip: a rectangle inside a rectangle. Only ever carries approval semantics.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #c98a2b; border-radius: 0; color: #a06a1c; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sheet Card

components.html:

components.css: .ds-sheet { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid #34343b; border-radius: 0; background: #f6f4ec; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #34343b; color: #6b6f76; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; } .ds-sheet-head span:first-child { color: #34343b; } .ds-sheet-media { margin: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(23,23,28,0.4); aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: #ffffff; } .ds-sheet-body { padding: 4px 16px 16px; } .ds-sheet-title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #17171c; margin: 0; } .ds-sheet-text { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; color: #6b6f76; }

components.name: Dimension Line
components.description: A measured rule with end ticks and a label, exactly like the dimension line beside a drawing.
components.css: .ds-dim { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b6f76; user-select: none; } .ds-dim span { width: 6px; height: 1px; background: #34343b; } .ds-dim i { width: 1px; height: 8px; background: #34343b; } .ds-dim .ds-dim-rule { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: #34343b; } .ds-dim b { white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Leader Callout
components.description: A leader line with a vertical tick pointing at a subject, with an uppercase mono label.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #17171c; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; } .ds-callout em { width: 20px; height: 1px; background: rgba(23,23,28,0.6); } .ds-callout i { width: 1px; height: 10px; background: rgba(23,23,28,0.6); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Mono uppercase link with a numeric index and a short rule that widens on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; background: #f6f4ec; border-bottom: 1px solid #34343b; padding: 12px 40px; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; color: #6b6f76; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link span { font-size: 10px; color: rgba(23,23,28,0.5); } .ds-nav-link i { align-self: center; width: 12px; height: 1px; background: rgba(23,23,28,0.4); transition: width 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #17171c; } .ds-nav-link:hover i { width: 24px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #34343b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bill-of-Materials Row
components.description: A table row with part number, description, a rating bar that fills on scroll, and a proficiency stamp.
components.css: .ds-bom { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 2fr 0.5fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(23,23,28,0.3); color: #6b6f76; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-bom strong { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #17171c; } .ds-bom > span:first-child { color: #34343b; letter-spacing: 0.15em; } .ds-bom-bar { position: relative; height: 8px; background: rgba(23,23,28,0.15); } .ds-bom-bar i { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; background: #34343b; } .ds-bom:hover { background: rgba(23,23,28,0.05); }

narrative.overview: This portfolio presents a developer's work the way a production drawing set presents a product: as a precise, dimensioned, revision-stamped set of shipped builds. Every surface is a drawing sheet — title block, grid paper, part numbers, leader callouts, revision stamps — so the visitor's mental model is an engineering spec that happens to be about a person, not a résumé that happens to use nice type. The system refuses the dark-terminal developer-portfolio default outright: no neon-glow dark mode, no gradient hero, no metric cards. Instead it commits to a quiet charcoal drafting-ink world over warm-white drawing paper, with exactly one ink-black field (the contact sheet's closing nameplate) and one honey-amber accent that only ever appears as a stamp of approval. Density follows the drawing table: annotation-heavy sections sit beside calm white passes, and the page ends on a stamped nameplate rather than a footer.
keyCharacteristics: Every visual element behaves like drafting apparatus — rules measure, callouts point, stamps approve.
Warm paper ground with charcoal ink; amber reserved for approval only (≤5% of any surface).
Square corners everywhere; depth comes from hairline borders and paper, never from shadow or lift.
Techno-grotesk display type with monospaced, tracked-out annotation labels.
Reading order is sheet-style: Sheet 01/05 … Sheet 05/05, each section a ranked or numbered figure.

rules.name: The Approval-Only Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where a revision or approval is being stamped. If an element is not granting approval, a live-demo link, or a stamp, it has no amber.

rules.name: The Mono-Labels Rule
rules.body: Share Tech Mono is the voice of annotation only: captions, measurements, part numbers, sheet metadata, buttons, and stamps. Body prose and headlines never set in mono.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Surfaces separate only by paper color and hairlines, never by shadow or elevation. A soft or ambient shadow anywhere is a foreign object on the drawing table.

rules.name: The Square-Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius is never applied to sheets, cards, buttons, or inputs. If a corner needs marking, it is squared and, at most, carries a corner registration mark.

dos: Do build every surface as a bordered drawing sheet with a mono metadata strip and a hairline grid ground where the sheet is a full-bleed frame.
Do use DimensionLine and Callout to annotate a subject rather than to decorate an empty area.
Do stamp only approvals in amber, and keep amber under ~5% of any surface.
Do run body prose at 65–75ch and keep more space above headings than below.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces — selection (blueprint-line fill, white text) is already part of the system.
donts: Don't add radius, soft shadows, or lift anywhere; the table is flat.
Don't introduce a neon/dark/gradient terminal aesthetic — it is the world's explicit anti-reference.
Don't set body or headline prose in the mono face; mono is the annotation voice only.
Don't use amber for structure, text emphasis, or decoration; it approves or it doesn't appear.
Don't mock up the grid or paper texture in a context that isn't a drawing sheet; it is surface, not wallpaper.
